استقبحنا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْبَحْنَا (istaqbaḥnā) /is.taq.baħ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
# اُسْتُقْبِحْنَا (ustuqbiḥnā) /us.tuq.biħ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
